evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds

observations.why: The contract is framed around reliability and non-loss (conservation) and the system's capability to deliver predictably (competence); the value language is in how the contract is pitched, not merely its content.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: The decision frame positions the agent as self-directing its own retrieval cadence (autonomy) and the system as capable of flexible delivery (competence); the value appeal is in the design choice, not just the mechanism described.
